key_idea: Bin index is (x-1)/s; the picture height is the maximum bin count.
sketch: Count items per bin with integer division (x-1)/s, take h = max count, then print rows from h down to 1 with '#' where count >= row and '.' otherwise, followed by a row of n hyphens. O(n*h + k). Pitfall: off-by-one in the bin index since values are 1-based and bin i covers (i*s, (i+1)*s].
